schema.text: Which factors most reduce your feeling of security from crime or harassment?

options.text: Lack of people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or harassing others
Harassment experienced or feared because of who I am or how I look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)
Long waits at stops in the evening
Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, obstructed views)
Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
Lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff)
Previous personal or reported incidents in the area
I don't feel insecure at all

it.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Quali fattori riducono maggiormente la tua percezione di sicurezza rispetto a reati o molestie?
it.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Scarsa illuminazione (ad es. strade buie, sottopassaggi)
it.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Assenza di persone nelle vicinanze (zone isolate o deserte)
it.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Persone aggressive o che molestano altre persone
it.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Molestie subite o temute per chi sono o per come appaio (es. genere, aspetto, origine, età)
it.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Lunghe attese alle fermate di sera
it.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Scarsa visibilità (ad es. angoli ciechi, visuale ostruita)
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Scarsa manutenzione (ad es. edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture danneggiate)
it.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Mancanza di sorveglianza o misure di sicurezza (ad es. assenza di telecamere o personale)
it.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Precedenti episodi personali o segnalati nella zona
it.#I don't feel insecure at all: Non mi sento mai a rischio

fr.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Quels facteurs réduisent le plus votre sentiment de sécurité face à la criminalité ou au harcèlement ?
fr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Mauvais éclairage (par ex. rues sombres, passages souterrains)
fr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Peu ou pas de personnes autour (zones isolées ou désertes)
fr.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Personnes au comportement agressif ou qui harcèlent d’autres personnes
fr.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Harcèlement subi ou redouté en raison de qui je suis ou de mon aspect (par ex. genre, apparence, origine, âge)
fr.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Longues attentes aux arrêts le soir
fr.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Trop de monde ou environnement désordonné
fr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Mauvaise visibilité (par ex. angles morts, vue bloquée)
fr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Mauvais entretien (par ex. bâtiments abandonnés, graffitis, infrastructures cassées)
fr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Manque de surveillance ou de mesures de sécurité (par ex. pas de caméra, pas de personnel)
fr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Incidents déjà vécus ou signalés dans la zone
fr.#I don't feel insecure at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en insécurité

de.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Welche Faktoren verringern Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl in Bezug auf Kriminalität oder Belästigung am stärksten?
de.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Schlechte Beleuchtung (z. B. dunkle Straßen, Unterführungen)
de.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Wenig oder keine Menschen in der Umgebung (einsame oder verlassene Bereiche)
de.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Menschen, die sich aggressiv verhalten oder andere belästigen
de.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Erlebte oder befürchtete Belästigung wegen meiner Person oder wie ich wirke (z. B. Geschlecht, Aussehen, Herkunft, Alter)
de.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Lange Wartezeiten an Haltestellen am Abend
de.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Schlechte Sicht (z. B. unübersichtliche Ecken, versperrte Sicht)
de.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Schlechte Instandhaltung (z. B. verlassene Gebäude, Graffiti, beschädigte Infrastruktur)
de.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Fehlende Überwachung oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen (z. B. keine Kameras, kein Personal)
de.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Frühere eigene Erlebnisse oder gemeldete Vorfälle in diesem Bereich
de.#I don't feel insecure at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht unsicher

tr.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Suça veya tacize karşı güvenlik hissinizi en çok hangi etkenler azaltıyor?
tr.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: Yetersiz aydınlatma (ör. karanlık sokaklar, alt geçitler)
tr.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Çevrede insanların olmaması (ıssız veya tenha alanlar)
tr.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Saldırgan davranan veya başkalarını taciz eden kişiler
tr.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Kim olduğum ya da nasıl göründüğüm nedeniyle yaşadığım veya korktuğum taciz (örn. cinsiyet, görünüş, köken, yaş)
tr.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Kötü görüş (ör. kör noktalar, kapanmış görüş alanı)
tr.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Kötü bakım (ör. terk edilmiş binalar, grafiti, hasarlı altyapı)
tr.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Gözetim veya güvenlik önlemlerinin olmaması (ör. kamera veya görevli olmaması)
tr.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Bölgede daha önce yaşanmış veya bildirilmiş olaylar

fa.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: کدام عوامل بیش از همه احساس امنیت شما را در برابر جرم یا آزار کاهش می‌دهند؟
fa.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: کمبود افراد در اطراف (مناطق خلوت یا متروک)
fa.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: افرادی که رفتار پرخاشگرانه دارند یا دیگران را آزار می‌دهند
fa.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: آزاری که به دلیل ویژگی‌های شخصی یا ظاهرم (مثلاً جنسیت، ظاهر، اصالت، سن) تجربه کرده‌ام یا از آن می‌ترسم
fa.#Long waits at stops in the evening: انتظار طولانی در ایستگاه‌ها در شب
fa.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: دید ضعیف (مثلاً گوشه کور، دید بسته)
fa.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: نگهداری ضعیف (مثلاً ساختمان متروک، دیوارنویسی، زیرساخت خراب)
fa.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: نبود نظارت یا اقدامات امنیتی (مثلاً نبود دوربین یا کارکنان)
fa.#Previous personal or reported incidents: اتفاق‌های قبلی که خودم تجربه کرده‌ام یا در آن منطقه گزارش شده‌اند

hu.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Mely tényezők csökkentik leginkább a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szembeni biztonságérzetét?
hu.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Kevés vagy egyáltalán nincs ember a közelben (elszigetelt vagy kihalt területek)
hu.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Agresszívan viselkedő vagy másokat zaklató emberek
hu.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Elszenvedett vagy attól tartott zaklatás amiatt, hogy ki vagyok vagy hogyan nézek ki (pl. nem, külső, származás, életkor)
hu.#Overcrowding or chaotic environments: Túl nagy tömeg vagy kaotikus környezet
hu.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: Rossz beláthatóság (pl. beláthatatlan sarkok, akadályozott kilátás)
hu.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Rossz karbantartás (pl. elhagyott épületek, graffiti, sérült infrastruktúra)
hu.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Megfigyelés vagy biztonsági intézkedések hiánya (pl. nincs kamera, nincs személyzet)
hu.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Korábbi személyes vagy bejelentett esetek a környéken

ar.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: ما العوامل التي تقلل أكثر من غيرها شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش؟
ar.#Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, unde: إضاءة ضعيفة (مثل الشوارع المظلمة أو الأنفاق)
ar.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: قلة الأشخاص حولك (مناطق منعزلة أو خالية)
ar.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: أشخاص يتصرفون بعدوانية أو يتحرشون بغيرهم
ar.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: تحرش تعرضت له أو أخشاه بسبب هويتي أو مظهري (مثل النوع الاجتماعي أو المظهر أو الأصل أو السن)
ar.#Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, o: رؤية ضعيفة (مثل الزوايا غير الواضحة أو الرؤية المحجوبة)
ar.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: سوء الصيانة (مثل مبانٍ مهجورة، كتابات على الجدران، بنية تحتية مكسورة)
ar.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: غياب المراقبة أو إجراءات الأمان (مثل عدم وجود كاميرات أو طاقم عمل)
ar.#Previous personal or reported incidents: حوادث سابقة عشتها شخصيًا أو تم الإبلاغ عنها في المنطقة
